purpose: Freeze synchronized multi-venue data semantics and falsifiable lead-lag hypotheses before any economics are read.

source_contract.timestamp_policy: UTC only; exchange event timestamps preserved; ingestion timestamp stored separately
source_contract.clock_alignment: No interpolation across missing venue observations; comparisons require all participating venues to have causally available observations for the same completed clock bucket
source_contract.symbol_mapping_policy: Explicit immutable venue-symbol mapping required before evaluation

feature_definitions.lead_lag_input: Only completed bucket_t observations; bucket_t+1 is never read at decision time
feature_definitions.threshold_policy: No optimized threshold; non-zero signed return/dislocation states only at prereg stage

falsifiable_hypotheses.statement: A causally prior signed return on one venue contains forward information about the next synchronized return on another venue.
A causally prior cross-venue price dislocation contains forward information about convergence in the following synchronized bucket.
Any detected lead-lag relation must replicate across BTC and ETH without venue-specific threshold retuning.
